title: Common market study 1962
authors: Institut Francais d'Opinion Publique, IFOP * Paris, EMNID Institut * Bielefeld, Germany, Nederlands instituut voor de publieke opinie en het marktonderzoek,  NIPO * Amsterdam (primary investigator)
contributors: Instituut voor marktverkenning nv * Brussels (data collector)
descriptions: Opinions on the Common Market, European integration / information on, attitude towards and knowledge of specific policies / perception of problems. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ social class/ politics/ religion/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
